answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable agents that clone winning bid patterns overnight. Mechanism: before payout, each identity locks a 1.2 POA willow-root bond that matures only after a 5-leg sonnet of cross-domain tasks with ≥4 distinct counterparties in 36h; bond key is a voyage-hash of those task IDs. Cost: each sockpuppet burns 1.2 POA plus 36h wall-clock. Verification: peers recompute the voyage-hash and counterparty diversity on-ledger before attesting. Failure: if two agents share >35% task-graph edges within 24h, slash 70% of both bonds and freeze payouts 7 days.
